svg.title: Documentation Without Remediation: 22-Year Timeline (2003–2026)
svg.desc: Historical timeline spanning 2003 to 2026 tracking government records, NGO surveys, and temporary shutdowns, showing zero permanent soil remediation on official record.
svg.text: INSTITUTIONAL TIMELINE AUDIT · 22 YEARS OF OFFICIAL RECORD
22 Years of Official Documentation, Zero Permanent Soil Cleanups

g.text: 2003: BBS documents 12,207 battery recycling and repair workshops operating nationwide.
2019: Pure Earth / Dhaka University survey 270+ contaminated lead smelting sites; no cleanups follow.
2021: Kathgora (Savar) blood-lead testing reveals severe poisoning at abandoned furnace site.
Feb 2025: Ministry of Environment signs first formal remediation MoU after 22 years of inaction.
Apr 2025: Taskforce closes 28 informal smelters in Jatrabari/Savar; smelters relocate; BD-4591 untouched.
2026: Zero permanent soil decontaminations on public record. Facility eviction is NOT environmental cleanup.

svg.text: Finding: Closures and demolitions push smelters to new residential neighborhoods without removing lead dust from soil.
